dogecoin.text: @elonmusk What if while you were building Tesla, one of the world's most influential people was constantly promoting the crappiest car company around, because they thought it was funny.  There are many crypto projects that blow Dogecoin out of the water.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs Elon, I’m sure you know of other superior coins like Cardano, DOT, etc. Why re-invent the wheel with doge?  Please let us all know your thinking on this, because it doesn’t seem to make sense.
